place.name: RN2, Le Plessis-Belleville / Silly-le-Long, Oise, France

observerOccupation.es: gendarme, al volante de la furgoneta

description.fr: Nous roulions sur la RN2 vers Nanteuil, vers 0 h 50, en patrouille. Devant nous, sur la gauche, bas sur l'horizon, deux lumières blanches très intenses, fixes, une à chaque bout, et près de celle de gauche une lumière rouge qui clignotait, allumée une demi-seconde, éteinte une demi-seconde. Ça restait sur place. En approchant, une masse sombre et plate est apparue autour des lumières, d'une largeur impressionnante. J'ai ralenti ; juste après le pont, elle était là, immobile, à gauche, un peu plus haut que le pont, au-dessus de la bordure opposée. Vue de côté puis de derrière : un V très aplati, gris, lisse comme du béton, aux arêtes nettes, et à l'arrière deux rectangles blancs éclairés uniformément qui s'allumaient et s'éteignaient ensemble, deux secondes allumés, deux secondes éteints ; éteints, ils étaient plus sombres que le reste. Je l'ai suivie dans le rétroviseur jusqu'à la perdre, près de Nanteuil, quand la route descend. Aucun bruit, mais le fourgon est très bruyant. La Lune, presque pleine, était dans notre dos.
description.en: We were driving on the RN2 towards Nanteuil, around 0:50, on patrol. Ahead, on the left, low on the horizon, two very intense white lights, steady, one at each end, and near the left one a red light that blinked, on for half a second, off for half a second. It stayed where it was. As we got closer a dark, flat mass appeared around the lights, impressively wide. I slowed down; just past the bridge it was there, motionless, on the left, a little higher than the bridge, above the far edge of the road. Seen from the side and then from behind: a very flattened V, grey, smooth like concrete, sharp-edged, and at the rear two evenly lit white rectangles that went on and off together, two seconds on, two seconds off; off, they were darker than the rest. I followed it in the mirror until I lost it near Nanteuil, where the road dips. No sound, but the van is very noisy. The Moon, almost full, was behind us.
description.es: Circulábamos por la RN2 hacia Nanteuil, hacia las 0:50, de patrulla. Delante, a la izquierda, bajas sobre el horizonte, dos luces blancas muy intensas, fijas, una en cada extremo, y cerca de la de la izquierda una luz roja que parpadeaba, encendida medio segundo, apagada medio segundo. Se quedaba donde estaba. Al acercarnos apareció alrededor de las luces una masa oscura y plana, de una anchura impresionante. Reduje la velocidad; justo pasado el puente estaba allí, inmóvil, a la izquierda, un poco más alta que el puente, sobre el borde opuesto de la carretera. Vista de lado y luego desde atrás: una V muy aplanada, gris, lisa como el hormigón, de aristas vivas, y en la parte trasera dos rectángulos blancos iluminados uniformemente que se encendían y se apagaban a la vez, dos segundos encendidos, dos segundos apagados; apagados, eran más oscuros que el resto. La seguí por el retrovisor hasta perderla cerca de Nanteuil, donde la carretera baja. Ningún ruido, pero la furgoneta es muy ruidosa. La Luna, casi llena, estaba detrás de nosotros.
description.it: Percorrevamo la RN2 verso Nanteuil, verso le 0:50, in pattuglia. Davanti, a sinistra, basse sull'orizzonte, due luci bianche molto intense, fisse, una a ciascuna estremità, e vicino a quella di sinistra una luce rossa che lampeggiava, accesa mezzo secondo, spenta mezzo secondo. Restava dov'era. Avvicinandoci, attorno alle luci apparve una massa scura e piatta, impressionante per larghezza. Rallentai; appena dopo il ponte era lì, immobile, a sinistra, un po' più in alto del ponte, sopra il bordo opposto della strada. Vista di lato e poi da dietro: una V molto appiattita, grigia, liscia come il cemento, dai bordi netti, e sul retro due rettangoli bianchi illuminati in modo uniforme che si accendevano e spegnevano insieme, due secondi accesi, due secondi spenti; spenti, erano più scuri del resto. La seguii nello specchietto finché la persi vicino a Nanteuil, dove la strada scende. Nessun rumore, ma il furgone è molto rumoroso. La Luna, quasi piena, era dietro di noi.

title.en: One object: a flat concrete-grey triangle and its lights
title.es: Un solo objeto: un triángulo plano gris hormigón y sus luces
title.it: Un solo oggetto: un triangolo piatto grigio cemento e le sue luci

track.rationale: One object, where T1 placed it (RN2 PK 5+500, PV p.7) and as still as he said it was (CR p.5, 33). Its sizes are his: 34 m across, which is the 30 m he gave and what it measures, 32 to 35 m, all along the approach at the sizes the GEIPAN's reconstitution fitted to his pointings (CR p.49-54); 2.4 m thick, what both his drawings give (the bar of drawing 004, the rectangles of drawing 005 that take its full thickness), rather than the 5 to 8 of his questionnaire; 20 m front to back, ASSUMED between his 'plus large que longue, mais de très peu' and 'trois fois sa longueur'. A full triangle, not a chevron: its straight rear face carries the two rectangles parallel and alike, as he drew them, and the front, where a chevron would be hollow, he never saw. Its underside 22 m above his eye (so 23.6 above the ground, which his eye is 1.6 m over), the middle of it 23 m above, which is what his elevations give at those distances. Its nose faces 194.5°, ASSUMED, towards the road he came along: the one heading from which he sees both its front faces, and so all three lights, until a few seconds before the bridge, as he said he still saw them 'juste avant le pont'. Seen from the front and far, low over the horizon, a flat triangle is the dark bar of drawing 004; from behind and below, close, it is drawing 005: its straight rear face a band, its underside below running away to the point, further and so lower, a V point down. What no heading does is hide the front lights from where he was once past the bridge: 3 s after he last saw them he is 40° further round, and the same faces still look at him. So they go out while the deck hides it, which is ASSUMED; he said only that he no longer saw them. The luminances of the lights are ASSUMED too: nothing measured them.
